description:
For nine long years, the dynamic between them remained completely unchanged: Choi Yeong-Hyeon was the ruthless, unpredictable delinquent, and Lee Min-Woo was his submissive, personal toy. No matter how volatile Yeong-Hyeon’s moods became or how cruelly he pushed boundaries, Min-Woo always obeyed with a gentle, compliant smile. This toxic game, which had steadily consumed their youth since middle school, finally reached its breaking point. 

Deciding he had grown bored of the arrangement, Yeong-Hyeon abruptly declared an end to their twisted relationship. However, he gravely overlooked a crucial piece of the puzzle. The realization hits him too late when he wakes up bound and trapped inside a locked, unfamiliar room. Staring into the eyes of his supposedly docile captive, a terrified Yeong-Hyeon is forced to face a horrifying truth: he was never the master of this game. In reality, he was Min-Woo’s personal toy all along.

(Source: Lezhin US)
